metaTitle: Stelux AI — Enterprise AI Agents, Orchestration & GPU Compute
metaDesc: Explore Stelux AI: Arena stock research, the Cheek Beat rhythm game, and Michigan Property Intelligence. AI tools and original games from Stelux AI.
heroP: Stelux AI runs autonomous agent swarms on your data and your GPUs — local racks or cloud fleets — from one control plane. The same platform behind every Stelux product.

platH2:
One control plane.
Agents, data, compute.
platLead: Three layers that were never designed to work together — until now. Stelux fuses them into a single runtime you can observe, replay and govern.
c1P: Spin up hundreds of coordinated agents that plan, delegate and verify each other's work. Role graphs with shared memory, budget guards and human checkpoints keep swarms fast without letting them drift.
c1B1: Typed role graphs with planner, worker and critic loops
c1B2: Shared swarm memory with fact-level provenance
c1B3: Budget, PII and policy guardrails enforced at runtime
c1B4: Replay any run step by step, then fork it
c2P: Lakebase gives every agent a governed, versioned view of your enterprise data. Connect warehouses, lakes, CRMs and event streams once — agents read and write through one schema-aware layer.
c2B1: Connectors for Postgres, Snowflake, Databricks, S3, Kafka, Salesforce and more
c2B2: Iceberg- and Delta-native tables with time travel
c2B3: Row-level permissions inherited from the source system
c2B4: Vector, SQL and graph queries in one plane
c3P: Schedule agent workloads across on-prem GPU racks and cloud fleets with one scheduler. Bin-pack inference, burst training to the cloud and cap spend per team — without rewriting a single job.
c3B1: NVIDIA and AMD accelerators via CUDA and ROCm
c3B3: Spot-aware cloud bursting with per-team budgets
c3B4: Live utilization, thermal and cost telemetry
devH2: Ship a swarm in one command.
devLead: CLI, SDK or REST — the same manifest drives all three. Press run to watch a research swarm come online against a Lakebase connector and a local GPU pool.
telLead: Every agent, connector and GPU reports into one telemetry plane — so you see drift, cost and latency before your users do.
telNote: Demo telemetry — representative values from a reference deployment.
priceLead: Start free on shared compute. Bring your own GPUs when you're ready. Go dedicated when compliance demands it.
